data.name: Azaan
data.gender_notes: Azaan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-ذ-ن (ʾ-dh-n), 'to announce, permit'. Adhān means 'call to prayer'. Its root is أ-ذ-ن (ʾ-dh-n). The Islamic call to prayer. Azaan is a Arabic name meaning “Call to prayer; announcement”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azaan total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
